Title: QnA Maker simplifies knowledge base management for your Q&A bot

Body.Content:
QnA Maker is an easy-to-use web-based service that makes it easy to power a question/answer application or chatbot from semi-structured content like FAQ documents and product manuals. With QnA Maker, developers can build, train, and publish question/answer bots in minutes.

We're excited to reveal the launch of a highly requested feature, Active Learning in QnA Maker. Active Learning helps identify and recommend variations for any question and allows you to add them to your knowledge base. Your knowledge base content won’t change unless you choose to add or edit the suggestions to the knowledge base. Learn more about Active Learning.
